article.title: Application by purchaser to set aside sale on ground of judgment-debtor having no saleable interest.
article.content: The purchaser at any such sale in execution of a decree may apply to the Court to set aside the sale, on the ground that the judgment-debtor had no saleable interest in the property sold.
article.html:
91Application by purchaser to set aside sale on ground of judgment-debtor having no saleable interest.

Order 21, Rule 91

The purchaser at any such sale in execution of a decree may apply to the Court to set aside the sale, on the ground that the judgment-debtor had no saleable interest in the property sold.
